# Text representations for finding a similar product (auto-generated by `python -m src.evaluation.product_similarity`)

Queries: 1,320 test products; database: 6,889 train/validation products (all with nutrition facts within physical limits). Prediction = nutrition of the most similar product (top-1) or the mean of the 5 most similar (top-5). Lower error is better.

| Representation | Sugars MAE | Fat MAE | Salt MAE | kcal MAE | Sugars MAE (top-5) | kcal MAE (top-5) | Same category |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline: database mean | 12.88 | 11.07 | 1.28 | 149.9 | - | - | - |
| Baseline: random product | 16.55 | 14.72 | 1.80 | 209.0 | - | - | 0.3% |
| Jaccard (word sets) | 6.98 | 6.12 | 1.03 | 79.8 | 5.94 | 72.7 | 15.4% |
| BoW + Euclidean | 7.99 | 9.73 | 1.26 | 107.6 | 7.52 | 90.2 | 12.5% |
| BoW + Manhattan | 7.84 | 10.48 | 1.22 | 111.7 | 7.70 | 95.0 | 12.6% |
| BoW + cosine | 7.31 | 6.19 | 1.11 | 82.9 | 6.55 | 76.5 | 14.2% |
| TF-IDF words + cosine | 7.31 | 6.59 | 1.33 | 87.7 | 6.60 | 80.5 | 14.5% |
| TF-IDF words+pairs + cosine (app) | 7.63 | 7.30 | 1.36 | 91.5 | 6.68 | 81.2 | 14.4% |
| ingredient2vec mean + cosine | 8.02 | 6.51 | 1.15 | 89.8 | 6.46 | 82.2 | 11.6% |
| TF-IDF + ingredient2vec + cosine | 6.99 | 6.23 | 1.04 | 79.7 | 5.99 | 73.6 | 14.9% |
